title: fix(fleet-queue): claim never hands out a payload-less/invalid packet; list gains --lane/--worker (#5444)
body: Fixes #5444 — queue task 12827. **Problem:** the claim path could hand a worker a payload-less or schema-invalid packet (2026-11-04: a payload-null claim crashed a worker's claim loop), and `fleet queue list` had no `--lane`/`--worker` filters, so a crashed worker's live claims could not be enumerated before lease expiry. **Changes:** - Turso `verb_claim` (the live backend): the candidate SELECT now excludes payload-less rows (`payload IS NOT NULL AND payload <> '' AND payload <> '{}'`); a quarantine sweep at claim start moves pre-existing payload-less queued/parked rows in the queue to `blocked` with the reason in `last_error` and a `blocked` event row; every picked row must pass `validate_packet` — the same validator `/enqueue` runs (the oracle) — or it is quarantined and the pick moves to the next candidate / no-claim. - Client `claim_output`: defense in depth — a row carrying a `payload` field that is null or an empty object degrades to the distinguishable no-claim marker with a loud stderr line. Rows without a payload field keep the #5486 verbatim contract (existing tests unchanged). - `fleet queue list --lane/--worker`: filters applied end-to-end — client flags → broker request → Turso `verb_list` (`lane_id`/`worker_id`) and the PostgREST broker path (`lane_id=eq.`/`worker_id=eq.`). - `pm-stack/opencode-claimant/migration-0025.sql`: Postgres parity record for `claim_repo_task` (quarantine sweep + candidate payload predicate); schema validation stays in the broker/client layers that serve both stores. **Tests:** `cargo test -p fleet-queue --all-features --all-targets` — 99 + 2 passed on the laptop, including new invariant tests whose oracle is `validate_packet`: claim guard accepts a valid packet, rejects the three payload-less shapes (missing field / null / `{}`), and rejects schema-invalid packets. Live `--lane/--worker` verification follows once the broker binary carrying this build is deployed from main. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.
